query:
WITH digests AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT checksum_sha256
            FROM proxy_cache_artifacts
            WHERE repository_id = $1 AND checksum_sha256 IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.verdict = 'clean')      AS "clean!",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.verdict = 'vulnerable') AS "vulnerable!",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.verdict IS NULL)        AS "not_scanned!"
        FROM digests d
        LEFT JOIN proxy_scan_results r
            ON r.checksum_sha256 = d.checksum_sha256
           AND r.scan_type = $2
